name: MQ-9A Reaper
note: General Atomics MQ-9A Reaper hunter-killer UAV (remotely piloted; 2-person ground crew). Endurance ~14 h fully armed, up to ~27 h clean. Primary weapons: AGM-114 Hellfire and GBU-12 Paveway II laser-guided bomb. Platform speed/radius/payload below are estimates (specifications table not captured on fetch).

name: Bayraktar TB2
note: Baykar Bayraktar TB2 medium-altitude long-endurance armed UAV. Endurance >20 h. Four hardpoints carrying MAM-L / MAM-C laser-guided smart munitions. Combat radius is limited by the line-of-sight datalink (~150 km) unless relayed.

name: Shahed-136
note: HESA Shahed-136 loitering munition (one-way attack drone; Russian designation Geran-2). The airframe is the weapon: a ~40-50 kg warhead delivered to ~2,500 km one-way. combatRadiusKm records the one-way reach, not a round trip.
